correctness.rationale: For all m>=1 and q prime coprime to m, root-of-unity minimal polynomial excludes repeated projected frequency labels, and distinguishes zero cross-fiber character products by simultaneous vanishing of all level-set Fourier coefficients. Fourier inversion gives the exact annihilator of the function period group. Counting independent coset values and Möbius inversion give q^|P| and every period stratum. Exact checker tests all frequency subsets in several cyclic orders including nonsquarefree; finite cases do not replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The full spectrum-partner period rigidity and Möbius multiplicity classification were not found in the central statements and relevant passages actually inspected. The 2026 transversal theorem proves the existence/shape of spectral sets, and its coefficient lemma is used and credited. The new claim describes *all compatible partner frequency graphs*, their exact number, and the distribution across every coprime prime-fiber graph family, including nonsquarefree cyclic orders. Residual possibility of a known equivalence under Hadamard-pair terminology is recorded, not ruled out categorically.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier period-annihilator or combinatorial Hadamard-pair classification could be equivalent.
The strongest overlap is Tan–Zhang’s cyclotomic lemma, which is deliberately credited as a proof ingredient; novelty is confined to the explicit complete spectrum family/count and distribution.
The long Malikiosis 2022 manuscript was sampled in targeted relevant passages rather than inspected exhaustively; a more subtle equivalent implication elsewhere in it remains possible.

value.rationale: Complete spectra and exact per-set spectrum multiplicities are natural invariants not determined by a bare Fuglede yes/no result. The proof reveals that the translation-period subgroup is the sole parameter controlling the count and gives a Möbius distribution over every coprime prime-fiber graph family. The composite m cases are not restricted to squarefree N; for m=6, q=5 the four distinct levels are 5,25,125,15625, a meaningful structural classification rather than a gratuitous small parameter enumeration.
